mainEntity.name: Can you handle structural changes as part of a multi-room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Frasheski Construction is equipped to handle structural changes as an integral part of multi-room remodeling projects. This can include removing load-bearing walls to open up spaces, adding new windows or doors, or altering rooflines for additions. Our team works with qualified engineers and ensures all structural modifications comply with local building codes in areas like El Cerrito or Kensington. We manage these complex aspects to ensure the safety and integrity of your home while achieving your desired open-concept or reconfigured layout.
